meta.label: Google Play Developer API
meta.description: Verify Android subscriptions and orders for Play Billing (subscriptionsv2, orders, acknowledge)
meta.note: Access token is minted at request time via service-account JWT-bearer exchange (account = service-account JSON with client_email + private_key, cached in-isolate until expiry) — no refresher cron needed. Key paths: GET /androidpublisher/v3/applications/{package}/purchases/subscriptionsv2/tokens/{token} and GET .../applications/{package}/orders/{orderId}. Probe needs a real package name (404 with valid auth = working).
